items.title: Audit the step contract matrix for complete inputs, outputs, evidence, missing-evidence handling, and verifier ownership
items.context: Review docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md Step Contract Matrix and Evidence Failure Policy for missing responsibilities or ambiguous proof sources.
items.userSees: User sees the heading "Step Contract Matrix" followed by rows for Step 0 through Step 7 and columns for inputs, outputs, required evidence, missing/stale handling, and verifier.

happy.desc: Step Contract Matrix has rows for state intake, PLAN skeleton, reviewer lanes, evidence, preflight, live smoke, delivery, and done_prepare delegation.

edge.desc: Rows distinguish upstream evidence refresh from TEST-to-DONE stale refresh owned by done_prepare.

adversarial.desc: No row allows stale proof to become fresh by direct hash rewrite or main-agent self-signing.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n '0\. State intake and phase preflight|1\. Story init / PLAN skeleton|2\. Verification evidence generation / refresh|3\. Validation, transcript, and delivery context preparation|4\. Reviewer lane orchestration|5\. REVIEW / TEST gate preflight|6\. TEST-to-DONE readiness delegation' docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Command checks the Step Contract Matrix row labels for the current 0-6 lifecycle contract, not the earlier Step 0-7 wording.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n 'TEST-to-DONE stale refresh remains|owned by .*done_prepare|done_prepare --dryRun|not a second implementation of DONE readiness' docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Document distinguishes upstream evidence planning from TEST-to-DONE stale refresh and DONE readiness owned by done_prepare.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n 'never rewrite hashes directly|delivery-check.json.*delivery reviewer lane|main agent must not self-sign|no track may introduce a second material/evidence/transcript freshness predicate' docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Document blocks direct hash rewrite, main-host delivery self-signing, and duplicate freshness truth sources.

items.title: Audit the text and image flowcharts for alignment with the step contract and B-fb36 done_prepare boundary
items.context: Confirm both flowcharts show proof-or-stop behavior and delegate TEST-to-DONE readiness to done_prepare instead of duplicating DONE closure logic.
items.userSees: User sees the heading "Flowcharts", a text flowchart block, and the image link "Lattice standard evidence pipeline flow" pointing at the SVG asset.

happy.desc: The text flowchart lists the full state intake through DONE delegation path with explicit stop points.

edge.desc: The image/SVG flowchart visually distinguishes ordinary preflight from TEST-to-DONE done_prepare delegation.

adversarial.desc: Neither flowchart depicts story_pipeline as independently running main merge, stale TEST evidence refresh, validation, or done_closure for DONE readiness.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n 'rerun-required evidence --> print rerun command and STOP|safely refreshable stale evidence --> delegate to existing refresh writer|missing user-value proof --> run smoke or require metadata-only waiver; if unavailable, STOP|Target is DONE and story is in TEST' docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Text flowchart now distinguishes rerun-required stop, refreshable loop, unavailable user-value proof stop, and DONE-target decision.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n 'Refresh-only stale|RERUN REQUIRED|Validation and user proof pass|FINDING -> DEV|Ready for non-DONE target|6\. Delegate to done_prepare|done_prepare PASS|BLOCKED' docs/requirements/decisions/assets/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-flow.svg && xmllint --noout docs/requirements/decisions/assets/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-flow.svg
verificationEvidence.note: SVG now includes refreshable/rerun branches, validation proof decision, reviewer finding to DEV, non-DONE ready branch, done_prepare delegation, blocked edge, and XML validity.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n 'Delegate to lattice done_prepare|duplicating .*done_closure.*main-sync.*evidence-refresh.*version-bump|not a second implementation of DONE readiness|never reinterpret a .*done_prepare.* blocker as pass' docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Flow and boundary text show story_pipeline delegates DONE readiness and preserves done_prepare blockers.

items.title: Audit the implementation split for safe parallel development without duplicate gate truth sources
items.context: Review the parallel tracks and suggested story breakdown for clear ownership, safe dependencies, and no second implementation of lifecycle gates, delivery review, or done_prepare behavior.
items.userSees: User sees Track A through Track G and P1 through P7 explicitly say DONE readiness is delegated to "done_prepare" where applicable.

happy.desc: P1-P7 identify owners, deliverables, dependencies, and parallel-safety notes.

edge.desc: Tracks that touch delivery, evidence refresh, review gates, or DONE readiness name their dependency on existing gates or done_prepare.

adversarial.desc: No track claims permission to replace reviewer lanes, delivery reviewer signatures, Authority receipts, or done_prepare TEST-to-DONE readiness behavior.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n 'Track A\. Pipeline State Model And Preflight|Track G\. Top-Level Story Pipeline Command|P1 \| Add story pipeline preflight report|P7 \| Integrate top-level .*story_pipeline.* command' docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Parallel development plan identifies Track A through Track G and P1/P7 integration ownership.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n 'Canonical Report And Freshness Source|P3 \| Add verification evidence planner/refresh orchestrator \| P1|P4 \| Add reviewer batch orchestration \| P1, P3, P5, P6|P3 must wait for P1' docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Implementation split now forces P3/P4/P6 through the P1 canonical report/freshness schema before final reviewer or delivery semantics.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n 'replace reviewer lanes with a single host self-review|delivery-check.json only through the delivery reviewer lane|no push, no Authority DONE claim|not by replacing it|no track may introduce a second material/evidence/transcript freshness predicate' docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-standard-evidence-pipeline-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Document rejects replacing reviewer lanes, delivery reviewer signatures, Authority claims, done_prepare behavior, or canonical freshness readers.

auditLog.reason: Step contract matrix and evidence failure policy documented and covered by docs_check evidence.
Text flowchart, Mermaid source, and SVG flowchart documented and covered by docs_check evidence.
Parallel development split documented and covered by docs_check evidence for done_prepare and gate truth-source boundaries.
